homeIntro: A focused iPhone app for workouts, plans, timers, and statistics that make training history easier to read.
stripLogBody: Add sets, weights, reps, duration, distance, and notes without fighting the UI.
stripPlanBody: Build exercises and workout templates, then apply them to any training day.
stripStatsBody: See volume, trends, heatmaps, category balance, and exercise history.
featureTitle: Everything starts from the training day.
featureIntro: FKNGYM is organized around the way you actually train: choose the day, open the plan, log the work, then review what changed.
calendarTitle: A workout calendar that stays close.
calendarBody: Switch between week and month rhythm, keep notes for the day, repeat workouts, and jump back into active exercises.
logBody: Each exercise keeps the input mode it needs, including timers for active work.
statsIntro: Full statistics unlock long-term history, trend comparison, category focus, and exercise progress views.
statVolumeBody: Compare categories, zoom through history, and keep previous periods in view.
statHeatmapBody: See which weeks were consistent and where training dropped off.
statExerciseTitle: Open the history behind a movement
statExerciseBody: Review how strength, distance, duration, and repetitions changed exercise by exercise.
plansBody: Save exercises, group them by category, mark favorites, and keep reusable workout schemes ready for the next day.
activeTitle: Timers that stay out of the way.
activeBody: Track timed sets, distance work, notes, and rest without breaking the rhythm of the workout.
pricingTitle: Start free. Go Pro for full statistics.
pricingIntro: Free mode is enough to log workouts. Pro opens the full analytics layer when you want to understand long-term progress.
supportBody: Send a question, bug report, subscription issue, or privacy request. I’ll reply from the FKNGYM support mailbox.
documentsIntro: How your data is handled, the terms for using FKNGYM, and help when you need it.
privacyCard: Data, storage, deletion, and privacy requests.
termsCard: Apple Standard EULA, subscriptions, and export restrictions.
supportCard: Contact the developer, manage a subscription, or get purchase help.
pricingNotice: Subscriptions renew automatically until canceled. The App Store purchase screen shows the current local price, billing period, and any eligible trial before you confirm. Read the subscription terms and Privacy Policy.
privacyIntro: This policy covers the FKNGYM workout app, this website, and messages you send to FKNGYM support. You can use the app without creating a FKNGYM account.
summaryLocal: Workout records are stored on your device.
summaryNoAds: No advertising networks or sale of workout data.
dataBody1: The app stores the workouts, exercise names and categories, sets, weights, repetitions, durations, distances, notes, and workout templates you enter. It calculates training statistics from these records and saves preferences such as appearance and report settings.
usageBody1: These records provide your workout history, plans, timers, and progress reports. The app shares relevant workout summaries and timer state with its own widgets and Live Activities on your device, so they can display and update your training information.
usageBody2: FKNGYM does not send your workout database to a developer-operated server. The developer cannot browse your local workout records. If you choose to include records or screenshots in a support message, the information you send becomes part of that correspondence.
storageBody1: Workout data is stored locally. The current app does not provide CloudKit synchronization between devices. Depending on your system settings, Apple may include app data in an iCloud device backup; a backup is separate from app synchronization. Restoring a device backup may restore older app records.
purchasesBody1: Apple processes App Store purchases and payment information. The app uses StoreKit transaction information, including the purchased product, subscription validity, and revocation status, to determine access to paid features. FKNGYM does not receive your payment card details. Apple keeps purchase records under its own policies.
supportDataBody1: When you email support@fkngym.com, the developer receives your email address, message, and any attachments you choose to send. This information is used to respond, investigate the issue, and handle privacy requests. Email providers process the correspondence to deliver and store it. Send only what is needed to explain the issue.
thirdPartiesBody1: FKNGYM does not sell personal information, include advertising networks, or track you across other companies’ apps and websites for advertising. Apple may process purchase, backup, and diagnostic information according to the services and sharing settings you enable. See the Apple Privacy Policy.
websiteBody1: This website is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub processes technical request information, including IP addresses, to serve and secure the site under the GitHub Privacy Statement. This is separate from your workout records.
websiteBody2: The site saves your selected language and App Store country or region in your browser’s local storage. You can remove these preferences by clearing site data. The site does not add advertising cookies or analytics scripts.
retentionBody1: Local workout records remain until you delete them using the app’s editing and deletion controls or remove the app’s data. To remove the app and its local data, use Delete App in iPhone storage settings; Offload App keeps documents and data. Backups are managed separately in your Apple device and iCloud settings. The developer cannot remotely delete your device data or Apple backups.
retentionBody2: Support correspondence is retained only as long as needed to handle the request and related follow-up, or to meet applicable legal obligations. You can request its deletion at support@fkngym.com; if any information must be retained, we will explain why. Apple and GitHub control retention of the information they process under their own policies.
retentionBody3: Deleting workout data or the app does not cancel an App Store subscription. See subscription management.
controlsBody1: You control what you enter in the app and send to support. Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, or a copy of personal information held in support correspondence, object to processing, or withdraw consent where processing relies on consent. Contact support@fkngym.com and describe your request. We can help with information we hold; we cannot retrieve a workout database stored only on your device.
childrenBody1: FKNGYM is not specifically directed to children. If you believe a child has sent personal information to support, contact us so we can review and delete it as appropriate.
changesBody1: Changes to this policy will be published on this page with an updated date. If the app’s data handling changes, the policy will be updated to describe it.
privacyContactBody1: For privacy questions and requests, contact the FKNGYM developer at support@fkngym.com. For app and purchase help, visit Support.
termsIntro: FKNGYM uses Apple’s Standard End User License Agreement. This page links to the governing license and explains how App Store subscriptions work.
termsSummaryControl: Manage purchases through your Apple Account.
licenseBody1: Your use of FKNGYM is governed by the Apple Standard End User License Agreement (EULA). Read the full agreement for the license scope, permitted use, termination, warranties, liability, and applicable law. This page is explanatory and does not replace or modify that agreement or mandatory consumer rights.
subscriptionTermsBody1: FKNGYM offers monthly and annual subscriptions for paid statistics features. Both periods provide the same subscription access. Before you confirm a purchase, the App Store screen shows the included features, full local price, billing period, and any offer available to your Apple Account. Prices and offer availability may vary by country or region.
renewalBody1: Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm a purchase, or when an eligible free trial ends. Subscriptions automatically renew for the selected period unless canceled before renewal. Apple may charge for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends.
renewalBody2: A trial is available only when offered on the purchase screen and when your account is eligible. That screen shows its duration and the price charged afterward. If you do not want a trial to renew into a paid subscription, cancel at least 24 hours before it ends. See Apple’s cancellation instructions.
manageTermsBody1: Manage or cancel in iPhone Settings → your name → Subscriptions → FKNGYM. Deleting the app does not cancel billing. The subscription screen shows when access ends; trial access may end when canceled. Purchase restoration and refund help are available on our support page. Refund requests for Apple-billed purchases are handled by Apple, subject to eligibility and applicable consumer rights.
exportBody1: Section (g) of the Apple Standard EULA sets out restrictions on use, export, and re-export, including applicable U.S. and local laws, embargoes, restricted parties, and prohibited end uses. Refer to that section for the full terms.
termsContactBody1: Read the Privacy Policy for information about data handling. For questions about FKNGYM or these subscription explanations, contact the developer at support@fkngym.com.
supportIntro: Get help with the app, purchases, or your data. Contact the FKNGYM developer at support@fkngym.com; no FKNGYM account or active subscription is required.
supportSummaryData: Workout records are managed on your device.
supportContactBody1: Email support@fkngym.com with your question or bug report. Include your FKNGYM version, iOS version, device model, what happened, and what you expected. Screenshots are optional; remove personal information that is not needed. Never send passwords or payment card details.
supportSubscriptionsBody1: Open iPhone Settings → your name → Subscriptions → FKNGYM. You can review renewal details and cancel there. Deleting the app or emailing support does not cancel your subscription. See Apple’s cancellation guide and our renewal and trial terms.
supportPurchasesTitle: Restore access or request a refund
supportPurchasesBody1: If paid features are unavailable, check that you are using the Apple Account that made the purchase and that the subscription is active. Connect to the internet, reopen FKNGYM, and use Restore Purchases on the subscription screen if you can access it. If you cannot reach that screen or access is still missing, contact support. See Apple’s purchase restoration guide.
supportPurchasesBody2: For purchases billed by Apple, request a refund from Apple. Eligibility depends on the purchase and applicable rules; submitting a request does not guarantee approval. See Apple’s refund guide.
supportRecordsBody1: Workout records are stored on your device. Edit or delete them in the app. FKNGYM support cannot remotely retrieve, restore, or erase a local workout database. For device backups, use Apple’s backup controls. See retention and deletion for details.
supportRecordsBody2: To request access, correction, or deletion of personal information you sent to support, email support@fkngym.com. Describe the correspondence concerned and your request. See the Privacy Policy.
